data.content_ref: inline:The claim that separation is unnecessary via adversarial mode (SRC_001) integrates with the 'Blind Spot Correlation' mechanism (SRC_005) by proposing that persona-induced latent path diversification acts as a synthetic decorrelation of error terms; this is refuted if the 'critic' persona merely produces a stylistic variation of the same high-probability hallucination without altering the underlying logical trajectory.
